items.text: Hi! My name is Wu Binbin.
Thanks, Sarah. / Thank you, Chen Jie.
I am nice to my friends.
Yes, I do. I have a cat.
Plants can give us many things.
Let's draw some purple and brown birds.
Great! Let's go to the shop!
Oh, one more cut for the dog.
How does he go to work?
He goes to work by bike.
How do you come to school?
In the USA people on bikes must wear one.
Don't go at the red light!
I must pay attention to the traffic lights!
What are you going to do tomorrow?
I'm going to have an art lesson.
We're going to draw some pictures in Renmin Park.
Does he like doing word puzzles and going hiking?
What does he do? They're afraid of him.
He's a businessman. The cat is angry with them.
Where does he work? What's wrong?
He works at sea. Your father is ill.
How does he go to work? He should see a doctor this
Better to ask the way than go A friend in need is a friend indeed.

He should see a doctor this morning.
